title: QEMU start failure performs verified reverse cleanup or quarantines
blocker: The repository has isolated VFIO-provider, QMP-gate and durable lease/FSM premises, but no production launcher/controller transaction proves backend-specific grant revocation, QEMU process/fd teardown, DMA, IRQ, reset, driver and lease cleanup after failures at every real spawn/readiness/realization boundary. Component success is not end-to-end product closure.
assertions: Current Legacy QEMU sees only the exact authorized BDF/group path sandbox; a separately qualified future cdev backend receives only inherited admitted fds
failure before QMP ready or topology verification executes the complete compensation stack in reverse order

The release guard remains exclusive while QEMU process/fds and guest DMA/IRQ context are proven gone, a fresh backend-specific reset context is acquired, and driver ownership is independently read back
any uncertain teardown or reset result preserves the durable whole-bundle claim in quarantine
